mapper.select: SELECT e.course_arrangement_id as courseArrangementId, c.name as courseName, COUNT(*) as evaluationCount, AVG(e.overall_score) as avgOverallScore, AVG(e.teaching_score) as avgTeachingScore, AVG(e.content_score) as avgContentScore, AVG(e.method_score) as avgMethodScore FROM course_evaluation e LEFT JOIN course_arrangement ca ON e.course_arrangement_id = ca.id LEFT JOIN course c ON ca.course_code = c.id WHERE e.course_arrangement_id = #{courseArrangementId} AND e.status = 'PUBLISHED' GROUP BY e.course_arrangement_id, c.name
